joinHint: Paste a link ending in /room/NAME. With the field empty, Join uses a room link from your clipboard.
roomLinkPlaceholder: Paste or type a room link…
connected: Connected. Waiting for the room's track.
connectionFailed: Could not connect. Check your connection and room link, then try again.
invalidRoom: Copy a complete room link ending in /room/NAME, then try again.
protocolRequired: This room needs a newer playback connection. Check that your server supports timeline playback v1.
invalidTimeline: The room's playback data could not be read. Rejoin the room to recover.
unsupportedTimeline: This room's playback format is not supported by this desktop version.
unsupportedSource: This track cannot be played here yet. YouTube tracks are supported.
empty: The room is quiet. Add a track to get the music going.
browserFailed: Could not open YouTube. Check that Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime is installed.
bridgeFailed: The player lost its connection. Rejoin the room to recover.
commandUnavailable: Playback controls will be ready once the room is synchronized.
commandRejected: The room did not allow that playback action.
autoplay-blocked: Select Enable playback in the video to turn on sound on this device.
unsupported-rate: YouTube does not support this playback speed.
error: YouTube could not play this track. Rejoin the room to retry.
providerError: YouTube could not play this track.
providerTimeout: YouTube took too long to respond. Rejoin the room to retry.
providerDeferred: Waiting for YouTube to start playback…
providerBlocked: YouTube needs permission to play on this device.
localVolume: Volume on this device · Left / Right to adjust
help: Undertone desktop: --server http://localhost:3000 --room NAME [--muted]. Or paste a full /room/NAME URL using the native Join button. --smoke-test starts offline, muted, and exits automatically.
accountExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
passwordAccountsOnly: Undertone password accounts only. Discord sign-in is not available in the desktop app.
catalogueNeeded: This track is not in the Undertone catalogue, so it can't be tagged. It will not be imported automatically.
createMoodHelp: Pick an icon and a name. Creating it doesn't tag this track.
createdMoodChoice: Created. Tag this track or favorite it below.
preferencesHelp: Choose the moods you want the room to play. Include: play tracks with any of your included moods. Exclude: avoid them. This doesn't tag the current track.
musicModeNeeded: Moods, adding tracks and the shared queue need a Music room and your live membership. Nothing about the room is changed from here.
renewHelp: Save and replace the room's automatic proposals. History and manual requests are kept.
addHelp: Search by title or artist, or paste a track link. Nothing is saved to a library.
addPermissionNeeded: Your role in this room can't add tracks.
musicSearchEmpty: No results. Try another title, artist or link.
musicSearchLimited: Showing the first 10 results. Refine your search to narrow them down.
confirmationHelp: Some listeners excluded moods on this track. Confirming applies only to this request and these exclusions:
confirmationIncomplete: Some names are unavailable. Refresh your requests before confirming.
refreshPendingHelp: The room changed. Refresh your requests.
queueRefreshNeeded: The queue changed. Refresh to see the latest page.
localSettingsHelp: A small always-on-top window. While it is open, closing this window minimizes it instead of stopping the music.
nativeQueueBusy: The native command queue is busy. Try your action again.
nativeNetwork: The request could not reach the server. Try again explicitly.
nativeAuth: Account validation failed (401). Sign in or check your account again.
nativeRateLimit: Too many requests (429). Wait before retrying.
nativeInvalidResponse: The server response could not be read safely.
nativeInvalidInput: Check the supplied values and try again.
nativeTls: Password sign-in requires HTTPS for remote servers.
nativeBusy: Another native operation is in progress.
nativeStale: Your account, the track or the room changed. Refresh before trying again.
nativeUnavailable: This operation is unavailable with the current membership or permissions.
musicConfirmation: This track needs your confirmation before it is added.
musicRevision: The room changed meanwhile. Retry the same action or refresh the room.
musicSlot: The next slot is already taken. Your request was not turned into a mix addition.
musicRequest: This request conflicts with another one. Refresh your requests.
musicInvalidConfirmation: That confirmation is no longer valid. Refresh pending requests.
musicNotFound: That request or track is no longer available.
musicUncertain: No clear answer from the room. It may have worked: refresh before retrying.
nativeOutcomeUnknown: This may have worked. Refresh to check before retrying.
preferencesAwaitingSync: Saved. Waiting for the room to update…
widgetFailed: Could not open the widget. Try again.
widgetPinFailed: Could not change always-on-top. Toggle the pin to try again.
widgetRestoreFailed: Could not restore the player. Use its taskbar button.
widgetMoodsHint: No moods yet. Open All moods to pick some.
widgetEnablePlayback: Open player → Enable playback to turn on sound
welcomeBody: Join a room to listen in sync with everyone, tag moods in one click and add tracks to the shared queue.
upcomingHidden: Upcoming tracks are hidden. Change this in Settings.
queueEmptyHint: Nothing queued yet. Add a track to start the mix.
musicModeShort: Moods and the shared queue need a Music room.
accountGuestBody: Sign in to tag moods on tracks, keep favorite moods and create your own.
signInToTag: Sign in to tag moods in one click.
noOwnMoods: Tag a mood or favorite one and it appears here.
noMoodMatch: No mood matches. Create it below.
tagAddTip: Add to your moods for this track
tagRemoveTip: Remove from your moods for this track
excludeTip: Avoid tracks with this mood. Manual additions ask for confirmation.
keepHelp: Save and keep compatible tracks in the queue.
addMixTip: The room fits this track into the shared mix.
addNextTip: Plays right after the current track. Never interrupts playback.
pendingNotLoaded: Refresh to see your pending requests.
volumeHelp: Volume and mute only change what you hear on this device.
upcomingSettingHelp: Hide them if you prefer surprises.
leaveHelp: Stops playback on this device and disconnects.
widgetNoRoomHint: Open Undertone to join a room.
nativeCredentials: Sign-in failed. Check your username and password, then try again.
searchEmpty: Type a title, an artist or a track link first.
searchTooShort: Type at least 3 characters, or paste a track link.
searchWait: Another action is still running. Search again in a moment.
searchRateLimitedLater: Wait a little, then search again.
searchRefused: The server refused this search (400): the daily search quota may be used up, or the query is too short. Paste a track link, or try again later.
searchRejected: The server could not complete this search
searchStale: The room or your account changed during the search. Search again.
searchUnavailable: Search needs a Music room where your role can add tracks.
searchTimedOut: No answer from the server yet. Search again to retry.
searchGateConnecting: Connecting to the room. Search will be ready in a moment.
searchGateNotMusic: This room is not a Music room, so tracks can't be added from here. The room owner can switch its queue to Music.
searchGateNotMember: You're not a live member of this Music room yet. Refresh the room to join it.
searchGateSession: Your session needs a refresh before you can search. Use Refresh room.
animationSettingHelp: Follows the Windows "Show animations" setting unless you choose. Always paused while the window is minimized, hidden or on another desktop.
